crossRefs.note: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says…

parallels.note: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

translations.web: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
translations.bsb: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
translations.kjv: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
translations.asv: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, so that they cannot arise: Yea, they are fallen under my feet.
